generationInputs.prompt: A digital illustration in a modern, geometric style with flat, bold colors depicts a white and tan Pikachu-like creature in a purple cereal bowl against a black star-scattered background, alongside tarot journal pages and sticky notes on a light brown surface. The white and tan creature, rendered with flat colors and sharp geometric shapes, sits in a purple bowl filled with light brown and white disk-shaped cereal pieces featuring red and black accents. White liquid, depicted with a smooth, solid fill, spills over the bowl's edge. The creature has solid black geometric shapes for eyes and a jagged black line for a mouth, with long, pointed ears having solid black tips. It appears to wear a draped purple costume with flat color blocks, one arm extending out of the bowl as a solid purple shape. Behind the bowl is a large, flat orange circle. Above the creature, the white letters "MIMIKYU'S" with a purple outline and drip effect are rendered as flat shapes. To the right, "Mola" is in a cursive purple flat color. To the left, curved white text reads "THE FAVORITE CEREAL OF YOUR GHOSTS". A purple starburst with a white outline contains the white text "FREE DISGUISE INSIDE". A purple rectangle lists white text for nutritional information. Three yellow square sticky notes with handwritten black marker text are arranged horizontally on a white background, each slightly tilted and casting flat shadows, consistent with the modern, geometric style. The text on the notes is rendered with sharp, clean lines.
